signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Dear ,

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 51, 102); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><font color="#003366">

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 51, 102); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><font color="#003366">
How are you?

<div style="color: rgb(0, 51, 102); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">
This is Evelyn from Hunan Standard Steel Co., Ltd in China.
Our company is a leading steel pipe manufacturer and exporter with decades of combined experience.
With equipment imported from USA and Germany, production as per international standards like API, ASTM, DN, DIN, EN and AS,
We can provide you best pipe solutions with competitive pricing
Here we provide our current basic price of ERW pipe for your attached reference:
Feel free to contact us if you have any new demands on above pipes!  Sincerely hope to cooperate with you in the near future!

<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">
If you have any inquiry, feel free to contact me, I wll try my best to quote you asap.
Have a nice day!

<hr size="1" align="left" color="#b5c4df" style="width: 210px; height: 1px; text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial;

text-decoration-color: initial;"><div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-transform: none; text-indent: 0px; letter-spacing: normal; font-family: arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; orphans: 2; widows: 2; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><span>
Best Regards
Evelyn
Xiang
Project Manager
Hunan Standard Steel Co., Ltd
